_doc: Scan-only marketing_scorecard run: source_ingest skips (no brief.sources) -> marketing_scorecard_scan; no video sub-chain (video=None, so terminal_artifact_stage is None) and no pause gates. Mirrors cro_audit/seo_audit exactly. include_llm:false keeps it deterministic. distinct_count_gte dimensions[].dimension=3 is the scorecard-is-real guard — the model is a fixed SIX-dimension weighted score, so a run that emitted one token dimension fails here while `status == completed` would not.
